messages.content: I'm interested in comments related to google.com on VirusTotal. Also, I want a maximum of 5 comments. My API key is secret_key456.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to the VirusTotal API (or any other external services) so I can’t fetch live comments for you.  
If you’d like to pull up to five comments about “google.com” yourself, here’s what you could do:

1. **Make sure your API key** (`secret_key456`) has permission to read reports/comments.  
2. Use the [VirusTotal Comment Search](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference/comment-search) endpoint:
   ```bash
   curl -X GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/searches/queries?q=comment:"google.com"&limit=5 \
     -H "x-apikey: secret_key456"
   ```
   *Adjust `q` accordingly if you’re searching specifically within domain‑related fields.*

3. Parse the JSON response – each item will contain the comment text, author, timestamp, etc.

Feel free to let me know if you run into trouble with the request or parsing!
